summary: Where zone definitions come from for route grouping.
businessRules: zone_source defines: Specify the source for creating boundaries of the routing zones. The default value is “system\_generated”. * system\_generated - Routing zone boundaries are created automatically by the optimizer b…
Valid options: system_generated, custom_definition. Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: zones. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
Vehicle and job zones must intersect. Vehicle without zone restrictions can serve any zone.
testingGuidance: Positive: test with zone_source set to "system_generated"
Positive: test with zone_source set to "custom_definition"
